directives.text: Add a '🎯 Verdict' line to every auto post, including NVDA, AMD, and AVGO, stating direction, conviction, key level, and action.
Label any one-touch level as 'reference zone' or omit it; do not call it support or resistance in NVDA, AMZN, and SMCI captions.
Round all prices and targets to at most 2 decimals; change SMCI's 42.375 to 42.38.
Keep discovery and week-ahead captions under 1800 characters, put the thesis first, and remove trailing ellipses.
Vary opening emoji and template across consecutive posts; avoid repeating the same category more than twice in a row.
Lead every caption with the ticker and a clear actionable conclusion, not the news source or a vague hook.
